descriptionChirho: Qal intransitive sense: of the sky, sun, day, or environment becoming dark or losing light, including cosmic and eschatological darkness.
Qal intransitive sense: of eyes or vision growing dim, typically with age or grief, so that one can no longer see clearly.
Qal intransitive sense: of skin or bodily appearance turning dark or blackened, as from suffering, famine, or mourning.
Hifil causative sense: to make dark, to bring about darkness, or to darken something, used of God or agents actively imposing darkness.
